title: howardia foetida
intro: Howardia foetida, commonly known as the "Desert Marigold" or "Mexican Gold Poppy", is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiseptic actions, which can help alleviate various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Howardia foetida include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
